description: $0.05 USDC on Solana - the payment buys one signed MCP auth-surface conformance report: submit the server's endpoint URL, its stated canonical URL, and its published declaration documents (protected-resource metadata, authorization-server metadata documents, server card; optionally your own capture of the unauthenticated challenge, graded only in a labelled self-reported tier). The service grades all 38 published checks (mcp-auth-surface/v1, MCP authorization revision 2026-07-28): the declaration checks from your documents, and the live-observation checks against the endpoint itself under the service's fetch fence (a refused or unreachable target is recorded not-observed, never guessed). The report carries the scope banner, the verdict line, every check grade, the coverage block and the evidence manifest, signed by the service - and no composite score. It grades the published declarations only: it is not a security certification and says nothing about behaviour behind authentication. The payment includes: the signed full report - every class-(i) check graded, every class-(ii) check graded or recorded not-observed, the coverage block, the evidence manifest - and nothing on the disclosure list.

asDocs.description: The authorization-server metadata documents (RFC 8414 / OIDC Discovery), keyed by issuer.

challengeObservation.description: An observed unauthenticated challenge for the challenge checks.

declaredRevision.description: The MCP authorization revision the operator declares (2026-07-28; a 2025-11-25 declaration exercises the transition labels).

endpointUrl.description: The MCP server endpoint URL whose published auth surface is graded.

intakeModes.description: The declared intake modes for the submission, per the criteria document.

manifest.description: The server manifest, if one is published.

prm.description: The protected-resource metadata document (RFC 9728) as published.

selfReportedCapture.description: Your own capture of the challenge; graded only in the labelled self-reported tier, never merged with observed evidence.

statedCanonicalUrl.description: The canonical resource URL the operator states for this endpoint; graded against the metadata documents.

name: auth_surface_check
